song.title: Thank You (Falettinme Be Mice Elf Agin)

guitar.evidence: Freddie Stone (Sly's brother) played guitar in the band, but no singular iconic signature instrument is widely documented for the act.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with low confidence.

tone.target: tight clean funk rhythm with wah sheen
tone.profile: tight clean funk rhythm with wah sheen
tone.summary: A punchy, dry signal chain utilizing a Compressor for attack definition, followed by a wah pedal, into a US Deluxe amp model paired with an American-style cab to achieve the required tight, clean funk sound.
corrections: keep it cleaner than lightly driven
center wah as the decisive effect
